sql: SELECT i.memo, e.subject, e.body FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.emails e ON e.email_id = i.email_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0009'
